decision: Close this task-search chain without a successor. No new pair, task search, author grant or experiment is released.
basis: R16 proposes another code diagnosis recoverable from ordinary files, not a distinct conversation-dependent setting.
The reviewed record names conversation-dependent work as a possibility but supplies no concrete task with a consequential conversation-only decision and an independent outcome check.
Removing ordinary notes or test documentation to create an advantage would change the baseline.
R9 and R14 support operational feasibility only; neither establish general benefit or its absence.
reopen_requirements: A concrete real-work task, with a sourced prior conversation decision relevant to its outcome.
An audit of what ordinary files and naturally written notes already provide; no artificial removal of these sources.
An independently justified success check and a comparison that can change the research decision.
next_action: At the scheduled revisit, check only whether new intake or a concrete supplied work case meets the reopening requirements. If not, retain no successor and record the next owned review. Do not launch a search or pair automatically.
stream_b: No further evaluator audit without a concrete new comparison; completed R15 result retained.
for_brian: The trials ran successfully, but another similar task would not answer whether memory helps. We are stopping this experiment chain until there is a better case.
